gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-martel-sans: Stately and slightly odd, Metamorphous wears its soft fat-and-slim strokes with a high midline. Martel Sans follows in generous, open curves that stay easy over many lines.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-matangi: Matangi reads hefty and round, its strokes like pressed twine. Metamorphous above it adds thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones, so a 40px heading over modest body text would show that off.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-maven-pro: Commanding up top, Metamorphous carries its soft fat and slim strokes with presence. Maven Pro then settles into a high-waisted lowercase and one unvarying line thickness, which keeps a long page of sans-serif text smooth and unfussy.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-michroma: Wide, stretched-out and futuristic, Michroma spaces every letter generously. Metamorphous is best at drawing attention with its large sidebearings and gradual weight shifts, and Michroma is best at laying out a plain sans line with tall, stubby-topped lowercase.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-miriam-libre: Metamorphous leans on large sidebearings and a high-set midline. Miriam Libre, a sans-serif drawn with wire-like weight and an s whose spine matches its terminals, carries a long stretch of text with sturdy, tall lowercase.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads as a big-eyed lowercase hung along a line, with one stroke width. Over a longer passage, that plain sans stays uniform against the light modulation Metamorphous only reveals up close.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spreads wide gaps between its letters and keeps a sizable lowercase drawn with a ballpoint's pressure-free line. A longer passage in this sans reads clean and friendly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-montserrat-underl: Neon-tube letters, bent at constant thickness, give Montserrat Underline its look, with breathing counters beside Metamorphous and its thin strokes not far from thick. A longer passage in this sans keeps an oversized lowercase against small capitals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. Under Metamorphous, with its moderate contrast and large sidebearings, the sans-serif text sits low-key while the heading gets to look distinctive.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall bodies that make its lowercase look bold, with terminals flaring outward. And across a long passage, that sans-serif holds steady beneath Metamorphous, whose joins taper modestly without vanishing.
